metadata.title: The Anatomy of a Court Case for Genealogists - James Tanner
metadata.author: BYU Library Family History Center
metadata.shortDescription:
Court cases are a great place to look for your ancestors. Luckily they don't have to be a criminal to find their name in a court record.
For more information: https://familyhistory.lib.byu.edu/all-webinars/the-anatomy-of-a-court-case-for-genealogists
